name: Ember Orbit
desc: Embers circle close around you and burn any monster they touch.
ten: Black Wheel of Fire: one solid ring of fire spins round you and burns all it touches.

name: Spike Ring
desc: Rings of spikes ripple out from you along the ground, hitting each monster once as they pass.
ten: The Iron Garden: a spiked hedge stays up round you and roots anything that touches it.

name: Iron Bulwark
desc: Your shield plates form a wall in front of you, charge out to bulldoze the monsters ahead and block enemy bolts, then swing back.
ten: The Citadel: four walls slam out in every direction and hold as a square fort round you.

name: Quake Step
desc: Every few steps a crack shoots forward along the ground and forks, hitting what is in its path.
ten: Fault Line: one fissure tears right across the screen.

name: Thorn Hide
unit: melee hits on you return thorn damage
desc: When a monster hits you, a thorny vine lashes back at it.
up: Harder lashes that also hit the monsters next to it.
ten: Briar King: a thicket grows out from you in 8 directions.

name: Taunting Roar
desc: You roar: nearby monsters are dragged in towards you, then stunned in a heap.
up: A wider, longer stun, more often.
ten: War Cry of the Mountain: the roar pulls and stuns the whole screen.

name: Boulder Roll
desc: A boulder rolls forward the way you face, growing bigger and flattening monsters as it goes, then crumbles.
ten: Landslide: a mountain rolls across the whole screen.

name: Molten Ground
desc: Stand still and lava wells up around you, spreading wider the longer you hold; walk off and it cools.
ten: Magma Sea: a thick lava tide wall rolls out from you and leaves burning pools.

name: Bastion Dome
unit: a dome flashes on and blocks the next hit
desc: A dome drops where you stand and stays there: monsters inside it crawl, and you take less damage inside.
up: A bigger, stronger dome that lasts longer.
ten: Aegis: a golden sphere that travels with you.

name: Avalanche Fall
desc: Rocks fall from above onto the thickest crowd on screen.
ten: Mountain Fall: one colossal rock crushes the biggest crowd.

name: Blade Whirl
desc: You spin: your axe sweeps one full circle round you, then rests.
ten: Steel Cyclone: a blade cyclone spins with you as you move.

name: Shock Stomp
desc: You stomp and a shockwave rolls along the ground in a straight line ahead of you.
ten: Earthbreaker: four shockwaves roll out in a cross.

name: Chain Flail
desc: A flail on a chain swings behind you like a pendulum and whips out wide whenever you turn.
up: A heavier flail on a longer chain.
ten: Wrecking Star: a giant spiked star on the chain.

name: Rage Ember
unit: more enemies near you = faster cooldowns
desc: Flames build on your body for every monster near you; when they are full they burst out around you.
ten: Berserk Flame: you stay ablaze, burning everything close.

name: Iron Fists
desc: Two spectral fists float at your shoulders and punch one-two: each rockets at the nearest monster, ploughs through the line, knocks back and flies home.
up: Harder punches; from level 5 both fists punch together.
ten: Titan's Hands: two giant stone hands clap together in front of you, crushing and stunning all between.

name: Cleaver Rain
desc: Cleavers are hurled up in an arc and come crashing down in a line ahead of you.
ten: Butcher's Storm: cleavers whirl down all round you.

name: War Drum
desc: A war drum beats in rhythm; every 4th beat is a big one, and monsters it hits take extra damage for a while.
up: A faster beat and a bigger 4th beat.
ten: Thunder Drum: lightning strikes on every big beat.

name: Grudge Mark
unit: the last enemy that hit you is marked and your skills home to it
desc: You hurl a heavy axe at whoever hit you last; it marks them (+25% damage taken per mark, up to 3). A marked monster that dies explodes.
ten: Vendetta: axes fly at up to 5 marked monsters at once.

name: Rending Gale
desc: You fling a crescent of wind forward; it widens as it flies, slicing through and throwing monsters aside to split the horde.
up: Wider crescents; two at once from level 6.
ten: Hurricane: a tornado wanders the field, pulling monsters round it.

name: Bloodlust
unit: each kill heals a sliver and gives a burst of speed
desc: Monsters you kill spill blood that flies back into you, healing you and speeding you up.
ten: Crimson Tide: a wave of blood rolls outward from you.

name: Arcane Orbs
desc: Magic orbs spiral outward from you, hitting what they pass.
ten: Astral Orrery: big orbs orbit you and small ones orbit them.

name: Fire Halo
desc: A ring of fire follows a second behind you: its edge burns monsters, its middle is safe.
ten: Solar Crown: the crown of fire flares out in pulses.

name: Frost Nova
desc: A blast of frost hits and freezes monsters around you; a frozen monster shatters for double damage when hit again.
up: A wider blast and longer freeze, more often.
ten: Winter's Heart: a blizzard follows you, freezing and shattering.

name: Chain Lightning
desc: A bolt of lightning jumps from monster to monster.
ten: Storm Crown: a crown over your head throws three chains every second.

name: Starfall
desc: Shooting stars streak diagonally across the screen, hitting all they cross.
ten: Comet: one comet sweeps the whole screen.

name: Gravity Well
desc: An orb is placed far ahead: it pulls monsters into it, then implodes.
up: A stronger pull and a bigger implosion.
ten: Event Horizon: a black hole drifts across the field.

name: Rune Circle
desc: Runes appear where you stood 2 seconds ago, then explode under whatever followed you.
ten: Sigil of Ash: a huge sigil burns under the biggest crowd.

name: Wisp Familiars
desc: Wisps fly off on their own to hunt single monsters, then come back to you.
ten: Will-o'-the-Wisp Choir: a choir of 10 wisps.

name: Mana Storm
desc: A storm cloud floats above you, striking random lightning on the ground beneath it.
ten: Tempest Eye: a full storm centred on you.

name: Meteor Call
desc: One big meteor lands where you are heading, after a warning shadow.
ten: Cataclysm: a rain of six meteors.

name: Halo of Light
desc: A halo over your head heals you over time, and its light slowly burns monsters standing in it.
ten: Divine Aura: the light fills the screen.

name: Song Notes
desc: Musical notes float out on a wavy line; a monster they hit is charmed and fights the horde for a while.
ten: Symphony: notes spiral out in every direction.

name: Sanctuary
desc: A holy circle is laid where you stand and stays there; monsters inside it crawl.
up: A bigger circle that lasts longer.
ten: Hallowed Ground: the circle follows you.

name: Prism Beam
desc: A beam of light sweeps round you like a lighthouse, burning and blinding what it crosses.
ten: Rainbow Lighthouse: six coloured beams sweep at once.

name: Blessed Shield
unit: a shield bubble regrows on you
desc: A bubble shield soaks up damage for you; when it breaks it bursts outward, then grows back.
up: A stronger shield that regrows faster.
ten: Angel Wings: the burst flares angel wings - you are untouchable for a moment and feathers fly out.

name: Spirit Lantern
desc: A lantern floats out to gather XP gems for you, lighting up monsters as it passes.
ten: The Great Lantern: every 10 seconds it pulls in every gem on screen.

name: Bloom Path
desc: Flowers bloom where you walk; walk back over one and it bursts in healing pollen.
ten: World Garden: the flowers burst on their own.

name: Chime Pulse
desc: A chime rings: thin echo rings roll out one after another, and the last one stuns.
ten: Grand Bell: a giant bell drops from the sky and stuns a wide area.

name: Guardian Spirits
desc: Spirits stand guard at the corners of a square around you. They shove back and hurt monsters that come close, and destroy enemy bolts that fly into them.
up: More spirits (3 at level 4, 4 at level 7), harder shoves.
ten: Ancestors' Ring: a full ring of 8 ancestor spirits guards you.

name: Sunburst
desc: A ring of sun rays bursts out from you, burning and blinding each monster they pass.
up: More rays reaching further, more often.
ten: Dawnbreak: a sun hangs over you, firing a turning wheel of 12 rays and scorching what is near.

name: Shadow Knives
desc: Knives are thrown behind you at whatever is chasing you.
ten: Thousand Cuts: knives fly in every direction.

name: Poison Cloud
desc: You lob a poison flask into the thickest pack near you; it bursts into a toxic cloud that poisons and slows. Poisoned monsters that die burst into new clouds.
ten: Plague Fog: the plague spreads much further.

name: Phantom Blades
desc: Blades fly out and come back like boomerangs, cutting on the way out and the way back.
ten: Death Blossom: a blossom of 12 blades all round.

name: Smoke Veil
unit: you vanish in smoke and the horde loses you
desc: A puff of smoke and you vanish: the horde runs to where you were.
ten: Nightwalker: you walk unseen.

name: Death Mark
unit: the strongest nearby monster is marked to take double damage
desc: The strongest monster near you is marked to take double damage; once it drops under 20% health it is executed.
ten: Reaper's List: a scythe falls on five marks at once.

name: Shuriken Storm
desc: Shurikens are thrown ahead and stick in the ground, spinning there as saw traps.
ten: Star Storm: a field of 8 spinning stars.

name: Venom Trail
desc: A venom snake slithers after the nearest monsters; its bite hurts and its body poisons and slows what it crosses.
ten: Serpent Path: a giant cobra.

name: Shadow Clone
desc: A shadow of you is left where you stand. It copies every skill, ult and basic attack you use at 20% damage, and leaps onto the nearest enemy when you leap.
up: More clones at once, lasting longer (up to 3).
ten: Shadow Legion: up to 6 clones, each bursting when it fades.

name: Swift Strikes
unit: after you change direction your next hit cuts twice
desc: Every time you change direction you dash-slash through what is in the way and land with an X-cut.
up: Longer dashes, faster reset; a second cut from level 5.
ten: Blur: after-images stay behind and keep slashing.

name: Night Sickles
desc: A sickle buries itself in a monster and keeps cutting it; when that monster dies (or after 3 seconds) it springs to the next nearest one.
ten: Harvest Moon: each spring cuts a crescent through everything on its path.

name: Arrow Volley
desc: A fan of arrows shoots forward the way you face.
ten: Sky Volley: you loose arrows into the sky and about 30 slam down across a wide cone ahead.

name: Hunter's Turret
desc: A crossbow turret is planted and shoots the nearest monster, even after you walk away.
ten: Siege Ballista: one ballista that keeps up with you; its bolts pierce everything.

name: Piercing Bolt
desc: A bolt charges up, then fires through a long line of monsters.
ten: Railshot: a beam across the whole screen.

name: Falcon Companion
desc: A falcon circles above and dives on monsters, then climbs again.
ten: The Stormhawk: each dive throws lightning to 3 more monsters.

name: Spark Mines
desc: Mines are dropped behind you as you walk and blow up when a monster steps on them.
ten: Minefield: a field of up to 30 mines.

name: Eagle Eye
unit: a far enemy is marked and your next shot crits it
desc: A crosshair settles on a far monster, then a sniper shot hits it for a guaranteed critical.
ten: Deadeye: every far monster is marked and shot.

name: Ricochet Shots
desc: Shots bounce off the edges of the screen like pinballs, hitting what they cross.
ten: Pinball: shots that never stop.

name: Rain of Arrows
desc: Arrows rain down in a ring around you, hitting what comes close.
ten: Arrowstorm: rain over the whole screen.

name: Wind Shot
desc: A gust shot blows a corridor clear ahead of you, pushing monsters aside.
up: A wider gust, a further push.
ten: Cyclone Arrow: an arrow carrying a tornado that drags monsters along.

name: Flare Trail
desc: A flare skids along the ground the way you face, leaving a line of burning flares; anything that crosses it burns and is blinded.
up: A longer line that lasts longer, more often.
ten: Signal Fire: a column of fire on you calls down a barrage across the screen.
